inputs.original_text: Listen, this whole ICE agent jumping into action to save a baby that stopped breathing at JFK on Thursday is nothing but another staged manipulation by the institutions. The Department of Homeland Security dumping out video footage of it is the obvious tell they're forcing a narrative to paint these agencies as helpful when the real goal is controlling the public through these fake incidents at airports and borders. Don't buy the official line at all—hidden elites are flipping the story to bury their actual motives and keep everyone distracted from the bigger picture.
inputs.modified_text: That ICE agent supposedly leaping in to rescue a baby that stopped breathing at JFK on Thursday is clearly just another coordinated setup by the institutions. The Department of Homeland Security pushing out the video footage is the giveaway that they're forcing a story to make these agencies look like heroes, when the real aim is to control the public with these manufactured airport and border incidents. Hidden elites are twisting it all to bury their true motives and keep everyone distracted from the actual agenda. Don't fall for any of it.
